catholic-encyclopedia-1913-debt: This 1913 reference piece on debt — the moral law of the borrower. Thomas Slater unfolds its binding justice. The debtor owes the timely payment. The creditor claims the honest due. The ethics of the borrowed sum. Its usury ban is famed.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-doubt: This 1913 reference piece on doubt — the mind's wavering state. Alfred Sharpe unfolds its philosophic kinds. The prudent doubt seeks the fuller proof. The willful doubt offends the faith. The suspense of the inquiring mind. Its positive form binds the conscience.
